interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add zebra-style markings to all legs of the intersection to improve pedestrian visibility and safety.

interventions.title: Complete Sidewalk Network
interventions.description: Construct a new sidewalk on the left side of the street to ensure continuous pedestrian access.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the parking lot entrance to specific, marked points to minimize vehicle-pedestrian conflict areas.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the sidewalk to provide a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or bollards between the sidewalk and the parking/roadway area to provide physical separation.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on at least one, preferably both, sides of the street to provide physical separation for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds on this residential street where pedestrians are present in the roadway.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees in the existing grass buffer would provide shade, improve the aesthetic, and help calm traffic by narrowing the perceived roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install lighting fixtures designed for the sidewalk to improve visibility and perceived safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Wall Art or Green Wall
interventions.description: Adding a mural or a vertical garden to the blank brick wall would improve the visual environment and make the walk more engaging.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Improve the quality and width of the existing walkway to enhance accessibility and provide a more comfortable pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk material and level across the driveway to signal pedestrian priority and slow entering vehicles.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings to provide a designated and visible crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracked pavement and remove debris/trash from the walkway area to ensure a clear, accessible path.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and provide a smooth, predictable surface for all users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Driveway Marking
interventions.description: Paint the sidewalk continuation across the driveway to clearly define pedestrian priority and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Warning Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Watch for Pedestrians' signage to mitigate the blind spot created by the building wall.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Expand the existing sidewalk to provide a wider, ADA-compliant walking path with a buffer from the roadway.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Curb and Gutter Installation
interventions.description: Install concrete curbs to clearly define the roadway edge and provide a physical barrier between the street and the pedestrian zone.

interventions.title: Designated Waste Storage
interventions.description: Provide off-sidewalk storage areas for trash and recycling bins to maintain a clear, accessible pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Trash Management Policy
interventions.description: Implement a policy or provide designated off-sidewalk storage areas for trash to ensure the pedestrian clear zone is maintained.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions or Planting Strips
interventions.description: Add a furniture zone or planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a buffer and space for utilities or trash without blocking the walkway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe walking path.

interventions.title: Designated Refuse Areas
interventions.description: Create dedicated off-sidewalk zones for trash collection to ensure the walkway remains clear and accessible.

interventions.title: Designated Trash Collection Areas
interventions.description: Provide specific off-street or recessed areas for trash collection to prevent walkway and verge obstruction.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Enhancement
interventions.description: Ensure pedestrian-scale lighting is provided once sidewalks are installed to improve nighttime visibility and safety.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to physically reduce vehicle speeds in this residential zone.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a planting buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffers
interventions.description: Incorporate planting strips or street furniture to create a physical separation between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the driveway and potential crossing points to improve sightlines.
